evidence.quote:
Tests that two lists or tuples are equal.  If not, an error message is

findings.text: assertEqual verifies that two objects are equal by dispatching the equality check to type‑specific methods; if no such method exists, it falls back to the objects’ __eq__ implementation (i.e., the == operator).

When the two values are not equal, assertEqual raises a failureException and, for built‑in types such as strings, lists, and tuples, includes a diff that highlights the differences in the error message.
The equality check is type‑sensitive: type‑specific methods can be registered to enforce that objects of exactly the same type compare equal, and mismatched types can trigger an error.
